title:
HE HADN'T EATEN
IN A DAY AND A HALF
notes: Montage in the @erez.v1 style: cut on visible action, natural audio, no music (Tal adds a sound in Instagram). Captions only on the hook and the one key line; every other beat is push.nocap. Chest-cam audio grafted where the chest cam was rolling (C0485 = VID059 - 85.00s, C0484 = VID059 + 2.19s). Rev 3: dropped the counter-wide beat (C0485 77-79.4): motion-blurred camera move on the rendered still.
beats: HOOK - 'Are you hungry?' 'Yes.' both in frame, chest-cam audio [full frame: the face-aim locked on Tal and cut Roman off]
walking him to the stall, side by side
THE GIVING - the plate lands in front of him [full frame: face-aim cut Roman off]
'My brother, cheers!' - food in his hands
eating [full frame: face-aim cut Roman off]
THE SECOND GIFT - Tal holds up the new shorts, both smiling (sharp frames 10:45-10:47; the earlier span was blurred) [full frame]
the reveal - new clothes, 'Are you happy now? You look good.'

KEY LINE - Roman rubbing his eyes, Tal beside him: "What doesn't kill us only makes us stronger." (the 279s line sits in continuous speech with no clean in-point, and the picture before it is a camera whip)
the pat on the shoulder and he walks on
